range_decision.evidence: A temporary offset is observed in the N/E/U components between indices 692 and 701: at index 692, all three components jump abruptly (N from ~1.8 to ~-5.6, E from ~-2.2 to ~18.3, U from ~-1.5 to ~-8.3), remain at elevated levels for 9 samples (indices 692–700), then return sharply at index 701 to near-pre-offset levels (N ~-5.1, E ~17.7, U ~-8.0), with subsequent values continuing the prior trend. The shift is sustained over multiple samples and reversed across all axes, satisfying the definition of a temporary observation offset. No other sustained multi-sample offsets with opposing returns are present.
